label: late original-phase step (t>=4) right after h/i/m/r/d/x
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase at positions t>=4 (99% of mass; rate peaks at orig_idx 5-6). It never fires at t<=2, during the copy phase, or (beyond a tiny amount) at the delimiter. The previous input token is the main modulator. After h or i the rate is about 23% and those cases dominate the top activations (precision 0.94 at t>=4). m, r, d and x come next, then 0 and l. Higher activations show up when the token is a first occurrence (in_first). The current token identity matters little. The predicate (t>=4, prev token in {h,i,m,r,d,x}) gets dev F1 0.68 and mass recall 0.81. Missed activations are mostly weak firings after other tokens at late positions.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: h, i, m, r, d, x; least: z, t, w, q) and the third original token (most: q, v, u, n, w, t; least: h, m, 0, r); timing cues that raise it most: t=5, t=6, t=4.
